question: Which Qwen configuration delivers useful quality, speed, cache behavior and context on this hardware?
method: An agent chooses bounded measurements from hardware evidence gaps: smoke first, then relevant coding work with tests and code review, diagnosis, context/cache tuning and unused confirmation work. The runner preserves exact configurations, first attempts, native rates and loaded/peak memory. Submission alone never establishes quality.

admission.rule: model files plus headroom must fit in three quarters of physical memory and in the GPU wired limit; a floor, not a fit prediction
